checks.summary: D1 root confirmed: lsp_completion_resolve ended in parse_completion_item(&resolved).or_else(parse_completion_item(&item)), so a provider error/null reached the renderer as a successful resolve that had merely lost its import edits. D2 root confirmed: parse_text_edit preferred the insert range and LspCompletionItem carried only one range, while CodeMirrorHost's Tab called acceptCompletion(view) with no intent. DEC-06 gap confirmed: an in-flight acceptance kept its closures and committed after Escape. All three now have a named production owner and a typed effect chain (source -> intent -> provider range -> one dispatch -> history).
scoped errors: 0; out-of-scope errors: 0 across 0 files.

checks.command: cd src-tauri && cargo test --lib completion_resolve_does_not_fallback_on_null_or_error && cargo test --lib completion_item_preserves_insert_replace_ranges
checks.summary: 2/2 new Rust tests pass: a resolve that produced nothing stays typed (null -> unavailable, transport error -> failed, deadline -> timeout) and never falls back to the original item; the completion parser keeps both InsertReplaceEdit ranges, leaves the shared insert-preferred textEdit field alone and rejects contradictory pairs.

checks.command: pnpm exec vitest run <11 completion, host, Action-dispatch and workspace files>
checks.summary: 11 files, 357 tests passed, including the ED-PARITY-005 names for enter/tab/mouse intent, invalidated acceptance on facts change, escape cancellation, stale gate callbacks, and the wire/outcome bridge.

1 passed, 98 steps in 23 s. Ctrl+Space, Alt+/ and the Search Everywhere Basic Completion action each open the same provider candidate; a repeated invocation at one caret stays a single list with one selected row and zero writes; Escape closes the list, returns editor focus and edits nothing; the same chord aimed at the Search Everywhere input never reaches the editor.

1 passed, 100 steps in 27 s. Enter and the mouse keep the trailing suffix through the provider insert range, Tab consumes the whole identifier through the provider replace range, each acceptance lands exactly one lang3 import, and one undo returns the exact Tmid preimage in all three rounds.

1 passed, 149 steps in 44 s. With the provider unavailable the editor falls back honestly, never claims a language-server candidate and does not report semantic-ready; recovery after the provider returns restores the list; an acceptance still waiting on resolve is cancelled by Escape with zero writes and is not revived by the late answer; switching A -> B -> A closes the popup, keeps both buffers and leaves a fresh request working.

1 passed, 139 steps in 34 s. A provider null resolve shows the gate naming `unavailable` with zero writes; Dismiss ends it with zero effect; a failed resolve shows `failed`; Retry reports its own failure and is disabled while waiting; recovery commits StringUtilsSuffix; plus the single import; the timeout round degrades explicitly through Insert-without-import, writing the primary edit only; every round's undo returns the Tmid preimage.

1 passed, 48 steps in 56 s on Linux/WebKitGTK against QA build com.taomni.app.qa. Real Tauri runtime, isolated data/config/cache, fixture project copy under the run report. Identical mid-word Enter/Tab ranges as the browser layer, and the saved bytes on disk follow both the acceptance and the undo (assert_file_contains on the copied App.java).

notes: Baseline: branch docs/code-workspace-idea-audit-20260913, worktree clean at 25921fd774dfaa7e5832bdaec00caa187f7f4a0e before any edit; all work on fix/code-workspace-parity005-basic-completion.
D1 and D2 were static gaps with no runtime reproduction available before the fix, so there is no pre-fix failing run to preserve; the renderer chain they sit on is covered by the new component tests.

Defects found and fixed while making the cases run, all in this card's path: (1) the Rust resolve boundary faked success; (2) the completion parser dropped the provider replace range; (3) an in-flight acceptance survived Escape; (4) running an editor action from Search Everywhere left DOM focus on <body>, so the list it opened could not be dismissed; (5) accepting a candidate left the list open over the resolve gate, making Retry / Insert-without-import / Dismiss unclickable; (6) the gate's own buttons dropped focus on <body>, which sent the undo of the acceptance to the shell instead of the editor and restored a corrupted preimage.

Pre-existing defect repaired: CodeMirrorHost.completion-undo.test.tsx had failed deterministically since 33865870 introduced a 75 ms interactionDelay; the assertion is unchanged and the repair only waits past the documented delay, matching the idiom already used in live-template-interaction.test.tsx. The same delay is why the new cases pause after the list opens.

The browser QA harness is a dev-stub harness armed only by the taomni.qa.parity005Completion.v1 key: inert without it and absent from native builds. It exists because the preview previously had no path to lsp_completion at all.
No commit, push or board status beyond this card was performed.
